title: One planner message for an infeasible Budget Lock scenario
heading: The Message States the Rules, the Arithmetic and One Checked Change
cases: the infeasible Budget Lock scenario yields the expected message: the clashing rules, every start combination's shortfall, and the smallest checked change
the filter drops whole families before single rows, so it finds the same three rules in 13 solves
after the filter, every row has its own bounds back and the model is as infeasible as before
a project planners forced in is one of the rules the filter can name
the change offered is the smallest raise that gives a plan, found by solving, not the snapshot's own figure
a project the scenario fixes to one year is listed as a rule and counted in the arithmetic
dollar amounts of $1,000k or more are written with a thousands separator
the $10k raises stop before they pass the snapshot figure, so no change is offered when the next step would pass it
